parts.what: Least-access roles, secret storage and two-person approval for risky actions.

parts.name: Dependency checks
parts.what: Licence and vulnerability checks on every dependency.

parts.name: Security reviews
parts.what: Outside reviews before each app goes live, and a page for reporting weaknesses.

parts.name: Traffic and abuse limits
parts.what: The one rate limiter: limits and protection from traffic floods, on which sign-up, spam, sign-in, API and agent rules are all set.

parts.name: Encryption and keys
parts.what: Encryption in transit and at rest for every service and backup, with key management, rotation and access logged.

features.name: Have admin work done in the open
features.does: Have staff act only through an admin console where every action is logged.

parts.name: Admin console
parts.what: Search members and orders and act on them, each action an operation with a stated reason.

features.name: Run our own server
features.does: Let a member group run its own servers and connect them.

parts.name: Self-host package
parts.what: Container images, guides and upgrade paths for member-run servers.

parts.name: Connecting member servers
parts.what: How member-run servers join, share data and stay trusted.

parts.name: Move an account between servers
parts.what: Moves a member's account and history between the co-op's servers and a member-run server, either way.

parts.name: Duties when members self-host
parts.what: Who carries sales tax, anti-money-laundering, privacy and safety duties when a member group runs its own servers, set out in the agreement each group signs.

features.name: Know how apps are used without being tracked
features.does: Know how apps are used from counts that never track a person.

parts.name: Private usage counts
parts.what: Usage counts in totals only, with no tracking cookies or personal profiles.

features.name: Have crashes fixed
features.does: Have app crashes reported, with my consent, so they get fixed.

parts.name: Crash reports
parts.what: Opt-in crash reports with personal data stripped out.

features.name: Install apps on many machines
features.does: Install, update and set up apps on every machine in an office or school at once.

parts.name: Many-machine installs
parts.what: Installs, updates and sets up apps on many machines at once through an organisation's own device tools and set-up files. Spare Construct and Spare OS both need it.

areas.name: Work law and worker status
areas.summary: One worker-status framework for every app: employee or contractor under the law's tests, agreements that meet them, personal grievances, minimum pay, holidays and leave, payroll, and retirement savings and accident cover guidance (example: New Zealand's KiwiSaver and ACC), switched on by each app's settings. Each country pack has its own rules, starting with New Zealand's. Proposed as svc-work (KIT-A16-F10-P1).

features.name: Know whether I am an employee or a contractor
features.does: Know my status in each app, why, and what it means for my pay, tax, vote and membership.

parts.name: Worker status test
parts.what: Applies each country's employment law tests, starting with New Zealand's, including its new gateway test for contractors (in force date *unverified*), to each app's way of working, checked by a lawyer.

parts.name: Worker status per app
parts.what: Each app's settings declare its workers' status, which switches on the matching pay, tax, agreement and membership rules.

parts.name: Contractor agreements
parts.what: Plain contractor agreements that meet the gateway test, versioned, with each worker's acceptance recorded.

parts.name: Employment agreements
parts.what: Written employment agreements for apps whose workers are employees, as employment law requires (example: New Zealand's Employment Relations Act 2000), versioned, with each worker's signed copy kept.

parts.name: Personal grievances
parts.what: A way for employee workers to raise a personal grievance within the 90-day limit, with mediation and every step recorded.

parts.name: Union access
parts.what: How unions reach and meet workers who work only through an app, under each country's union access rules (example: New Zealand's Employment Relations Act; *unverified* how they apply to an app).

features.name: Get paid what the law says
features.does: Know my earnings meet the minimum the law sets for my status, with holiday pay and payroll handled where I am an employee.

parts.name: Minimum pay top-up
parts.what: Checks earnings per hour of engaged time against the minimum wage where it applies, and tops them up in the next payout.

parts.name: Holidays and leave
parts.what: Works out annual holidays, public holiday pay, and sick, bereavement and family violence leave for apps whose workers are employees.

parts.name: Payroll provider link
parts.what: The one payroll provider link, for co-op staff and employee workers alike, which handles pay tax, retirement savings and payroll filing (example: New Zealand's PAYE, KiwiSaver and payday filing).

parts.name: Savings, accident cover and tax guidance
parts.what: Plain guidance for each status on retirement savings, accident cover levies and income tax in each country (example: New Zealand's KiwiSaver and ACC), linked from the earnings page.

parts.name: Leave law changes
parts.what: Keeps leave rules current as each country's law changes, such as New Zealand's move from the Holidays Act 2003 to the Employment Leave Act 2026's hours-based leave, which applies from the first pay period on or after 6 August 2028, with agreements updated in time.

parts.name: Wage and time records
parts.what: The wage, time, holiday and leave records employment law requires for employee workers, kept from their shift and online records. Spare Food and Spare Ride both need them.

features.name: Know platform work law in other countries
features.does: Know what platform work law asks in each country an app opens in.

parts.name: Platform work law per country
parts.what: Laws on platform work overseas, such as the EU Platform Work Directive and Australia's minimum standards, and what each changes in matching, ranking and pausing. Spare Ride, Spare Food and Spare Work need them.

areas.name: Health and safety at work
areas.summary: The co-op's health and safety duties, built once: an incident register, notifiable event reports, work-time limits, help after violence or a crash, and hazard notes. Proposed as svc-work (KIT-A16-F10-P1).

features.name: Know the co-op's safety duties
features.does: Know what health and safety duties the co-op owes me while I work through an app, whatever my status.

parts.name: Health and safety duties
parts.what: The co-op's duties under each country's workplace safety law, for workers whatever their status, starting with its duties as a person conducting a business or undertaking under New Zealand's Health and Safety at Work Act 2015 (platform position *unverified*).

features.name: Record and report an incident
features.does: Record an injury, near miss, assault or crash at work, and know it is reported to the regulator when the law says.

parts.name: Incident register
parts.what: Records injuries, near misses, violence and crashes during work as operations, with follow-up actions.

parts.name: Notifiable event reports
parts.what: Flags events that must be notified to the safety regulator (example: New Zealand's WorkSafe) and tracks the notice and the duty to keep the scene as it was.

features.name: Not be worked to exhaustion
features.does: Have the app stop offering me work when I reach a fatigue or work-time limit.

parts.name: Work-time limits
parts.what: Hooks for each app's fatigue and work-time limits, such as online hours and breaks, that pause offers when a limit is reached.

parts.name: Shared work-time record
parts.what: One record of each person's online and engaged time across every Spare app, so work-time limits count all their work and nobody types it twice.

features.name: Get help after violence or a crash at work
features.does: Get safety, support and the right reports started after an assault or crash during a job.

parts.name: Violence and crash handling
parts.what: Steps after an assault or crash during a job: safety first, support, the incident record, insurance and any notice to the regulator.

features.name: Know the hazards of a job
features.does: See hazards to know before a job, such as a dog, steep stairs or a dangerous site.

parts.name: Hazard notes
parts.what: Hazard notes on a place or listing, added by customers or past workers and shown before a job is accepted.

areas.name: Signatures, forms, notices and training
areas.summary: Tools many apps need that no single app should own: electronic signatures with an audit trail, one form model, formal notices served the way the law asks, and one module for courses, quizzes and certificates. Proposed as svc-sign and svc-training (KIT-A16-F10-P1).

features.name: Sign a document
features.does: Sign an agreement in any app and get a copy with a record of who signed and when.

parts.name: Electronic signature rules
parts.what: What each country's law asks of an electronic signature, starting with New Zealand's, and which documents need more than a click.

parts.name: Signatures with audit trail
parts.what: Signing flows for any app, with a tamper-evident audit trail and a signed PDF copy for every party.

features.name: Take a course and keep my certificates
features.does: Take a short course, pass a quiz and keep a certificate that apps and member roles can check.

parts.name: Training and certificates
parts.what: Courses, quizzes, completion records and renewals for any role in any app, such as worker orientation, moderators and panel members.

parts.name: Course screens
parts.what: Shared screens to take a course and show a certificate.

features.name: Fill in a form
features.does: Build or fill in a survey, quiz, application or request form that works the same in every app.

parts.name: Form model and builder
parts.what: One form model and builder for surveys, quizzes, applications and request forms, with question types, logic and a preview on phone and computer. Spare Office and Spare Studio both map form builders; whether Spare Office's moves here is OFF-A9-F1-P6.

features.name: Serve a formal notice
features.does: Send a notice the law requires, such as a tenancy or sale notice, and prove how and when it arrived.

parts.name: Address for service record
parts.what: Each party's agreed email and postal addresses for service, with the date each was given, used by agreements and notices. Spare Rent and Spare Home both need it.

parts.name: Notice builder
parts.what: Fills a notice from the agreement, works out the dates and renders an accessible PDF. Spare Rent's tenancy notices and Spare Home's sale notices to tenants use it.

parts.name: Proof of service
parts.what: Records how a notice was served, by the agreed email, post or hand, and when it counts as received; delivery in the app alone is not service.

parts.name: Notice clocks
parts.what: Legal clocks for notices on the kit's working days, adding the extra days each way of serving allows.

areas.name: Property records, ownership and tenancy rules
areas.summary: One shared record for each property with its chattels and repairs, proof of who owns or acts for it, decisions between co-owners, hand-over to a new owner, viewings, simple floor plans, owner statements and one pack of tenancy law, used by Spare Home, Spare Rent and Spare Stay so none of them depends on another. Built in kit-market as shared data; the document vault is KIT-A15-F13.

features.name: Keep one record for a property
features.does: Keep one record of a property's land, title, buildings, rooms, access facts, rates, past jobs and past sales that every app working on it shares.

parts.name: Property record
parts.what: Land, title, buildings, rooms, accessibility facts, rates, zoning, past jobs and past sales for one place, every change an operation, with each app adding its own fields.

parts.name: Property data sources
parts.what: Which official land, title, rates and zoning data the record may load, such as title and parcel data from each country's land agency (example: LINZ in New Zealand) and council rating information, under what licence and at what cost, done once for every app.

parts.name: Who sees what, and what passes on
parts.what: Rules for who may see each part of the record, such as an owner, tenant, guest or worker, and what passes to a new owner on sale, so private details and past jobs never reach the wrong person.

parts.name: Chattels and appliances
parts.what: One register of the rooms, chattels and appliances in a place, with make, model, manuals, warranties and service dates. Spare Home, Spare Rent and Spare Work's completion packs use it.

parts.name: Repairs and maintenance history
parts.what: Problems, repairs, costs and records of work for each place, linked to reports and jobs, and passed to the next owner where the rules allow. Spare Rent, Spare Stay and Spare Work need it.

parts.name: Body corporate details
parts.what: The body corporate's contact, levies and rules stored against a unit. Spare Home and Spare Rent both need them.

features.name: Record who came to a viewing
features.does: Sign visitors in at an open home or viewing, and know who came and when.

parts.name: Visitor register
parts.what: Records who came to an open home or viewing and when, from a check-in code or the host's phone, kept only as long as the retention schedule allows.

features.name: Have tenancy law applied the same way everywhere
features.does: Have tenants' rights, entry notices and notice periods applied the same way whether a home is rented out or sold.

parts.name: Tenancy rules pack
parts.what: The tenancy rules Spare Rent and Spare Home both need, such as written notice to tenants, consent before entry, rights about photos and viewings, and notice periods after a sale, as one versioned pack in each country pack, starting with New Zealand's.

parts.name: Tenancy law check
parts.what: A lawyer checks the pack against each country's tenancy law (example: New Zealand's Residential Tenancies Act 1986), and again whenever the law changes.

features.name: Prove I own or control a property
features.does: Prove I own or control a place before I list it, so nobody can list a home that is not theirs.

parts.name: Owner name match
parts.what: Matches a verified name against the owners on the record of title and flags any mismatch, though a name match alone never proves ownership. Spare Home and Spare Rent share one check.

parts.name: Proof of control
parts.what: Confirms the person controls the place through the rates assessment number, their lawyer or a code posted to the property, and never by a posted code alone for a home someone else lives in.

parts.name: Notice to the owner of record
parts.what: Posts a letter with a code to the owner's address of record whenever a listing starts, telling them how to stop it, where that address may lawfully be used (*unverified*).

parts.name: Ownership review
parts.what: A trained member settles the cases the automatic checks cannot, through the one review queue, with every decision logged.

features.name: Act for a property as a trust, estate or company
features.does: Sell, buy or let as joint owners, a trust, an estate or a company, with each person's part clear.

parts.name: Owning parties
parts.what: Joint owners, trusts, estates and companies as one owning or buying party, with each person's identity and role. Spare Home and Spare Rent both need it.

parts.name: Kinds of authority
parts.what: Each kind of person acting for an owner, such as a trustee, executor, attorney or company director, and the evidence each must give, per country.

parts.name: Authority evidence check
parts.what: Collects trust deeds, probate, powers of attorney and company records, keeps only the reviewed result and deletes the documents.

features.name: Decide together as co-owners
features.does: Bring every owner in and have the big steps agreed by all of them.

parts.name: Co-owner invitations
parts.what: Invites each owner on the title to join and confirm who they are and their share. Spare Home and Spare Rent both need it.

parts.name: Every-owner approvals
parts.what: Sets which steps need every owner to agree, such as going live, changing the price or accepting an offer.

features.name: Hand a property to a new owner
features.does: Pass a property's record, documents and any tenancy to its new owner when it sells.

parts.name: Property hand-over
parts.what: Passes the record, plans, documents and appliance details to the new owner when the seller agrees, tells tenants who their new landlord is and guides the bond transfer, the old owner keeping only their own accounts. Spare Home and Spare Rent share one flow.

features.name: Book a viewing
features.does: Book a viewing or open home, in person or by live video.

parts.name: Viewing slots
parts.what: Open homes and private viewing slots with limits on numbers, the lister's approval if chosen, and the exact address shared only once booked. Spare Home and Spare Rent use them, and Spare Market's item viewings can too.

parts.name: Live video viewings
parts.what: Books and runs a live video viewing on the kit's call service, with no recording unless both agree.

features.name: Draw a simple floor plan
features.does: Draw or bring in a simple floor plan with room sizes, with no design skills needed.

parts.name: Simple plan drawer
parts.what: Lets a person trace rooms with set sizes, doors and windows with no design skills needed, on the shared 2D drawing engine. Spare Home, Spare Rent and Spare Stay share one drawer.

parts.name: Plan import
parts.what: Imports a plan exported in an open format, such as one from Spare Construct, or a PDF or image with its copyright owner and licence recorded.

parts.name: Plan output and room areas
parts.what: Draws a plan as an image, a PDF and a plain text room list for screen readers, and works out room and floor areas, stating how they were measured.

features.name: Send statements to owners when a manager runs the place
features.does: Give owners a monthly statement when a manager runs their place.

parts.name: Owner statements
parts.what: Monthly statements for owners whose places a manager runs: income, payouts, costs, the manager's at-cost fee and sales tax. Spare Stay and Spare Rent both need them.

areas.name: Shared engines
areas.summary: The heavy engines several programs share: GPU rendering, 2D drawing, text, PDF, and video and audio, plus two proposed engines for office files and AI models run on the device. They are built in projects/engines, not in the kit, and depend only on the kit; they are mapped here so every program has one place to depend on and none depends on another. Names other than the five existing engines are proposals (KIT-A16-F10-P1).

features.name: See 3D and 2D views drawn fast
features.does: Open and move around large models, drawings and designs smoothly, on a computer or in a browser.

parts.name: Renderer choice
parts.what: Our own renderer on wgpu, or a web renderer first, covering instancing, culling and browser support, decided once for Spare Construct and Spare Studio.

parts.name: GPU renderer
parts.what: The engine-render renderer for 3D and 2D views: instancing, levels of detail, GPU culling and positions relative to the camera, compiled native and to WebAssembly.

parts.name: 3D viewport
parts.what: A fast viewport with lighting, materials and camera controls, shared by Spare Construct and Spare Studio, with a plain fallback for slow devices that Spare Home's tours can use.

parts.name: Path-traced rendering
parts.what: Realistic path-traced still images with an open denoiser, shared by Spare Construct and Spare Studio.

features.name: Edit photos on the device
features.does: Edit a photo quickly on my phone or computer, with the same tools in every app.

parts.name: GPU image pipeline
parts.what: Tiles, filters, blending and adjustments as GPU compute with a CPU fallback, one image pipeline for Spare Studio and the photo tools in other apps.

parts.name: Simple photo editor
parts.what: Crop, rotate, straighten, exposure, colour and a before-and-after view on phone and web, built on the image pipeline. Spare Social, Spare Market, Spare OS and the listing apps share it.

parts.name: Colour management
parts.what: ICC profile transforms for photo and print and OpenColorIO for video, keeping colour profiles and HDR correct from camera to screen. Spare Studio, Spare Social and Spare OS need it.

features.name: Draw lines, shapes and charts
features.does: Draw precise lines, shapes and charts that look the same on screen, on paper and in a PDF.

parts.name: 2D drawing core
parts.what: The engine-draw2d core: lines with true weights, fills, patterns, paths and shapes drawn on the GPU, used by Spare Construct drawings, Spare Studio vectors and Spare Office shapes.

parts.name: Path booleans
parts.what: Robust 2D boolean operations on curves, shared by Spare Studio and Spare Construct.

parts.name: Chart engine
parts.what: Bar, line, pie, area, scatter and other charts drawn from data, each with a text description and a data table for screen readers. Spare Office, Spare Studio, the ledger pages and seller insights share it.

features.name: Think together on a whiteboard
features.does: Sketch, write and pin ideas on one endless board with other people.

parts.name: Whiteboard canvas
parts.what: An endless canvas with ink, shapes, sticky notes and images, edited together, shared by Spare Office's whiteboard and Spare Studio's mood boards.

features.name: Set text in any language
features.does: Read and write text in any language and script, spelled and laid out properly.

parts.name: Text shaping and layout
parts.what: Font loading, shaping, bidirectional and complex scripts, vertical text, colour and emoji fonts, line breaking and paragraph layout, shared by Spare Studio, Spare Office, Spare Construct and Spare Social.

parts.name: Spelling and hyphenation dictionaries
parts.what: Open dictionaries for each language, starting with the example country's (for New Zealand: English and te reo Māori, then Pacific languages built with native speakers), each licence checked, used by every app's spell checker.

parts.name: Input methods for drawn text
parts.what: IME composition, dead keys, compose keys and easy macron typing for text drawn on a canvas, on desktop and in the browser. Spare Studio, Spare Office and Spare Construct need it.

parts.name: Open font catalogue
parts.what: One catalogue of fonts under open licences, such as the SIL Open Font License, covering every major script, with what each licence allows for embedding, print and the web. Spare Studio, Spare Office, Spare OS and Spare Construct share it.

parts.name: Long-document layout
parts.what: Fields, footnotes, tables of contents, indexes, cross-references, headers and footers, and accessible EPUB export, shared by Spare Studio's layout tools and Spare Office's documents.

features.name: Read, write and sign PDFs
features.does: Open, make, mark up, sign and print PDFs that work everywhere and with screen readers.

parts.name: PDF reader and writer
parts.what: Reads, views, edits and writes PDF to ISO 32000-2 with embedded fonts, layers and bookmarks, used by every app that makes or shows a PDF.

parts.name: Tagged, archival and print PDF
parts.what: Tagged PDF/UA, archival PDF/A and print-ready PDF/X output, with headings, reading order, table headers and alt text passed in by each app.

parts.name: Documents from templates
parts.what: Fills a versioned template from an app's data and renders an accessible PDF, for agreements, notices, statements, receipts, brochures and packing slips. Spare Rent, Spare Work, Spare Home, Spare Ride and Spare Market all make documents this way.

parts.name: PDF markup
parts.what: Clouds, text, arrows, stamps and every standard PDF annotation type, read and written to the specification. Spare Construct, Spare Studio and Spare Office share it.

parts.name: Certificate signatures
parts.what: Digital certificate signatures with long-term validation and a trust store, shared by Spare Studio, Spare Office and the kit's signing flow.

parts.name: Page recovery
parts.what: Rebuilds paragraphs, columns, tables and images from PDF pages, for PDF to layout and PDF to office files. Spare Studio and Spare Office share it.

parts.name: Scan to PDF
parts.what: Edge finding, perspective fixing and clean-up for photos of paper, with a searchable text layer from text recognition. Spare Studio, Spare Office, Spare OS, Spare Home and Spare Rent need it.

parts.name: Printing
parts.what: Sends what an app shows to the system's print service through engine-pdf, with preview, page choices, paper sizes and scaling. Spare Construct, Spare Studio, Spare Office and Spare OS need it.

features.name: Remove what should not be shared
features.does: Remove hidden data and redact content for good before a file is shared.

parts.name: True redaction and hidden data removal
parts.what: Removes chosen content for good, including any text under it, and strips hidden data, metadata and scripts before a file is shared. Spare Construct, Spare Studio and Spare Office need it.

features.name: Play, edit and record video and audio
features.does: Play, record and edit video and sound on any device, with captions and a record of how it was made.

parts.name: Codec and patent study
parts.what: One study of which video, audio and image formats to decode and encode and how to avoid patent and licence risk, merging Spare Studio's, Spare Social's and Spare OS's codec research.

parts.name: Decoding and encoding
parts.what: Decodes and encodes the chosen formats, using hardware where the platform offers it, with image sizes and short videos compressed for phones. Spare Studio, Spare Social, Spare OS and every listing app need it.

parts.name: Timeline and keyframes
parts.what: One timeline model for tracks, clips and edits as operations, with keyframes and easing for every property, shared by Spare Studio's apps, Spare Social's short video editor and Spare Office's slide animation.

parts.name: Audio engine
parts.what: Low-latency playback, recording and mixing on every platform, with even loudness, shared by Spare Studio and Spare Social.

parts.name: Captions and extra tracks
parts.what: Reads and writes open caption and subtitle formats, and carries audio description and extra language tracks. Spare Studio, Spare Social and the kit's captions share it.

parts.name: Content credentials
parts.what: Reads and signs C2PA content credentials with an openly licensed library, so edits and AI use stay visible. Spare Studio, Spare Social and Spare Home need it.

parts.name: Signing certificate for content credentials
parts.what: How the co-op gets, stores and rotates a certificate from a provider on the C2PA trust list, done once for Spare Studio and Spare Social.

features.name: Stream live to many people
features.does: Stream a live event or video to thousands of viewers with a short delay.

parts.name: Low-delay live streaming
parts.what: Streams live video to many viewers with a short delay, shared by Spare Social's live video and Spare Office's large events.

features.name: Open office files anywhere
features.does: Open and save common document, spreadsheet, slide and mail files in any app that needs them.

parts.name: Office formats engine
parts.what: Reads and writes DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, ODT, ODS, ODP and RTF from their published standards, below Spare Office, Spare Studio and Spare Construct's spreadsheet export, so none depends on another. Proposed as engine-formats (KIT-A16-F10-P1).

parts.name: Mail and notebook file readers
parts.what: Reads Outlook data files, saved messages and notebook files from Microsoft's published specifications, for Spare Office's importers and Spare OS's move from Windows.

parts.name: File encryption
parts.what: Reads and writes password encryption for office files and PDFs from their published specifications. Spare Office and Spare Studio both need it.

features.name: Make many documents from data
features.does: Make one page, letter or design for each row of a sheet or contact list.

parts.name: Data merge
parts.what: Makes a page, record or message for each row of a sheet, CSV file or contact group, with previews, for Spare Studio's data merge and Spare Office's mail merge.

features.name: Run AI models on the device
features.does: Have text read from pictures, speech turned into text and text read aloud on my own device, with nothing sent away unless I choose.

parts.name: On-device model runtime
parts.what: Runs open models on the processor, graphics chip or AI chip, for text recognition, speech, voices and image tasks. Spare Studio, Spare OS, Spare Social and Spare Office need it. Proposed as engine-models (KIT-A16-F10-P1).

parts.name: Open model choices
parts.what: Which open models for text recognition, speech recognition and voices may be used under their licences, how accurate each is, and how models for indigenous languages, such as te reo Māori, follow indigenous data principles, decided once for every program.

parts.name: Text recognition
parts.what: Recognises printed and handwritten text in photos, scans and receipts on the device, for search, copying, scanning and receipt reading. Spare Office, Spare Studio, Spare OS and Spare Rent need it.

parts.name: Speech recognition
parts.what: Speech to text for captions, transcripts, dictation and voice control, on the device or on co-op servers at cost, in many languages, starting with the example country's (for New Zealand: English and te reo Māori). Spare Social, Spare Office, Spare Studio and Spare OS need it, and the kit's captions use it.

parts.name: Text-to-speech voices
parts.what: Natural voices in many languages from open models, for read aloud, screen readers and offers read to drivers, with voices in indigenous languages, such as te reo Māori, used only on terms that respect indigenous data sovereignty. Spare Office, Spare OS, Spare Studio and Spare Ride need them.

areas.name: Own sites, public pages and feeds
areas.summary: Helps members reach people outside the apps: their own web address, fast public pages that web search can find, listing feeds to other sites, simple shop and booking sites, and a customer list with newsletters, all on the same checkout and seller of record rule. Built on kit-market and the file service; the service name is open (KIT-A16-F10-P1).

features.name: Use my own web address
features.does: Use my own domain for my shop, site, email or profile, with security set up for me.

parts.name: Domain verification
parts.what: Proves an account or organisation owns a domain through a DNS record or a file on the site before it is used, such as for an organisation's email and sign-in, a shop's address or a profile handle. Spare Office, Spare Social, Spare Market and Spare Stay need it.

parts.name: Custom domains
parts.what: Connects a member's own domain to their shop, booking site or portfolio, checks its records and issues free security certificates automatically.

parts.name: Free web addresses
parts.what: A free address for members without a domain, on a separate domain listed on the Public Suffix List so one member's site cannot read another's.

features.name: Be found through web search
features.does: Have my public listing found through web search and shared with a clear preview.

parts.name: Public listing pages
parts.what: Fast, server-rendered pages for every public listing, place and region that anyone can open without signing in, and that keep working after a listing ends. Spare Home, Spare Rent, Spare Stay and Spare Market need them.

parts.name: Web search basics
parts.what: Page titles, descriptions, structured listing data in an open vocabulary, site maps and tidy addresses for every public page.

parts.name: Share cards
parts.what: Preview cards with a photo, the title and the full price when a public link is shared, built without tracking who opens them.

features.name: Send my listings to other sites
features.does: Show my listing on other property, travel and shopping sites from one place.

parts.name: Where listings can go
parts.what: Which property, travel and shopping sites accept listings by feed, at what cost and on what terms.

parts.name: Listing feed service
parts.what: One service that sends listings, changes and withdrawals to other sites, and publishes an open feed of public listings and full prices, with each site's format as a plugin. Spare Home, Spare Rent, Spare Stay and Spare Market share it.

features.name: Run my own shop or booking site
features.does: Have a simple site in my own name and colours that takes bookings or orders through Spareware.

parts.name: Own site builder
parts.what: A simple site in the member's own logo and colours, with a set-up guide, that uses the same listings, checkout and seller of record rule as the app. Spare Food, Spare Market and Spare Stay need it.

parts.name: Booking box and embeds
parts.what: A small booking or ordering box and a QR code that members can put on a site they already have. Spare Ride, Spare Stay and Spare Food need it.

features.name: Keep a customer list and send newsletters
features.does: Keep my own list of customers and send news to those who asked for it.

parts.name: Customer records
parts.what: A seller's own list of customers with their orders and consent, kept to what privacy law allows and never shared with other sellers. Spare Market and Spare Work need it.

parts.name: Newsletters
parts.what: Simple newsletters and follower messages sent only to people who opted in, with a named sender and one-step unsubscribe, as anti-spam law requires. Spare Market and Spare Food need them.

features.name: Buy a web address at cost
features.does: Buy a domain name through Spareware at the registrar's own price.

parts.name: Domains bought at cost
parts.what: Whether the co-op can sell domain names at the registrar's price, and the rules for country domains such as .nz. Spare Office and Spare Market both ask.

assess: Does the map cover every journey a member takes across the apps: first sign-up, a first job, being paid, a dispute, a vote, a meeting and leaving the co-op?
Is the core set the smallest that gets the first marketplace and the member portal live, or is something marked core that can wait?
